description: CHARACTERS — a body with a rig you can play, print or watch: create_character as a hero (a person by cast word, proportions, face, hair, clothes and armour), a creature (a dragon, a monster, a plush toy, any invented body) or an animal (a real species). Plays its clips on the World page and exports skinned. Open for 'a hero for my game', 'a low-poly knight I can rig', 'a cute plush bear', 'a dragon I can animate', 'a wolf I can 3D print', 'give her a ponytail and broader shoulders'.

args.description: The member's arguments, as its manual specifies.

manual.description: A member name, or a list: returns just their manuals (description + inputSchema).

tool.description: Member to call. Omit to open the pack: a menu of its members.

title: Characters: heroes, creatures & animals
